scope: Python standard-library SQLite synthetic fixture only; no model, Devin, warehouse, MCP or Metabase execution; not production security or text-to-SQL accuracy proof. All rows invented.
weekly_sql: WITH RECURSIVE weeks(w) AS (SELECT '2026-01-05' UNION ALL SELECT date(w,'+7 days') FROM weeks WHERE w<'2026-01-26'), eligible AS (SELECT * FROM users WHERE tenant=? AND signup>=? AND signup<? AND is_test=0) SELECT w,count(e.id) AS signups FROM weeks LEFT JOIN eligible e ON e.signup>=w||'T00:00:00' AND e.signup<date(w,'+7 days')||'T00:00:00' GROUP BY w ORDER BY w
channel_sql: SELECT coalesce(channel,'unknown'),count(*) FROM users WHERE tenant=? AND signup>=? AND signup<? AND is_test=0 GROUP BY coalesce(channel,'unknown') ORDER BY 1
naive_join_sql: SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT u.id),sum(e.amount) FROM users u LEFT JOIN events e ON u.id=e.user_id WHERE tenant=? AND signup>=? AND signup<? AND is_test=0
dedup_sql: SELECT sum(amount),sum(amount IS NULL),sum(amount=0) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id,user_id,amount FROM events)
unknown_amount_policy: 10 is known partial sum, not total revenue; one NULL remains unknown. Zero-filled week requires known complete fixture coverage.
